mapper.select: SELECT app_id, client_type, environment, event_type, event_code, module, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), session_id)) AS uv, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration FROM base_stat_event WHERE occur_time >= #{startTime} AND occur_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY app_id, client_type, environment, event_type, event_code, module
